from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, davies_bouldin_score

np.random.seed(42)
X, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=300, centers=4, n_features=2, cluster_std=0.6, random_state=42)

print(f'Dataset shape: {X.shape}')
print(f'Feature 1 - Min: {X[:, 0].min():.2f}, Max: {X[:, 0].max():.2f}')
print(f'Feature 2 - Min: {X[:, 1].min():.2f}, Max: {X[:, 1].max():.2f}')

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], alpha=0.6, s=50)
plt.xlabel('Feature 1')
plt.ylabel('Feature 2')
plt.title('Original Data')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('original_data.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

inertias = []
silhouette_scores = []
K_range = range(2, 11)

for k in K_range:
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    kmeans.fit(X_scaled)
    inertias.append(kmeans.inertia_)
    silhouette_scores.append(silhouette_score(X_scaled, kmeans.labels_))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
axes[0].plot(K_range, inertias, 'bo-')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Number of Clusters (k)')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Inertia')
axes[0].set_title('Elbow Method')
axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

axes[1].plot(K_range, silhouette_scores, 'go-')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Number of Clusters (k)')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Silhouette Score')
axes[1].set_title('Silhouette Score by k')
axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('elbow_silhouette.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

print('Silhouette Scores:')
for k, score in zip(K_range, silhouette_scores):
    print(f'k={k}: {score:.4f}')

optimal_k = 4
kmeans_final = KMeans(n_clusters=optimal_k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
clusters = kmeans_final.fit_predict(X_scaled)

silhouette = silhouette_score(X_scaled, clusters)
davies_bouldin = davies_bouldin_score(X_scaled, clusters)

print(f'Optimal k: {optimal_k}')
print(f'Silhouette Score: {silhouette:.4f}')
print(f'Davies-Bouldin Index: {davies_bouldin:.4f}')
print(f'Cluster sizes: {np.bincount(clusters)}')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
scatter = plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=clusters, cmap='viridis', s=50, alpha=0.6)
plt.scatter(kmeans_final.cluster_centers_[:, 0], kmeans_final.cluster_centers_[:, 1], 
            c='red', marker='X', s=300, edgecolors='black', linewidths=2, label='Centroids')
plt.xlabel('Feature 1')
plt.ylabel('Feature 2')
plt.title(f'K-Means Clustering (k={optimal_k})')
plt.colorbar(scatter, label='Cluster')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('kmeans_clusters.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from PIL import Image
from sklearn.datasets import load_sample_images
from sklearn.feature_extraction import image
import seaborn as sns

sample_images = load_sample_images()
img = sample_images.images[0]

print(f'Image shape: {img.shape}')
print(f'Image dtype: {img.dtype}')
print(f'Pixel value range: [{img.min()}, {img.max()}]')

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.imshow(img)
plt.title('Original Image')
plt.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('original_image.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

patches = image.extract_patches_2d(img, (10, 10, 3), max_patches=100, random_state=42)
print(f'Extracted patches shape: {patches.shape}')

patches_reshaped = patches.reshape(patches.shape[0], -1)
print(f'Reshaped patches: {patches_reshaped.shape}')

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
scaler = StandardScaler()
patches_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(patches_reshaped)
print(f'Scaled patches: {patches_scaled.shape}')

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

pca = PCA(n_components=50)
patches_pca = pca.fit_transform(patches_scaled)

cumulative_variance = np.cumsum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.plot(range(1, len(cumulative_variance) + 1), cumulative_variance, 'bo-')
plt.xlabel('Number of Components')
plt.ylabel('Cumulative Explained Variance')
plt.title('PCA Explained Variance')
plt.axhline(y=0.95, color='r', linestyle='--', label='95% Variance')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('pca_variance.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

print(f'Variance explained by 50 components: {cumulative_variance[-1]:.4f}')

from sklearn.cluster import MiniBatchKMeans

kmeans_image = MiniBatchKMeans(n_clusters=16, random_state=42, n_init=5)
labels = kmeans_image.fit_predict(patches_scaled)

print(f'Cluster labels shape: {labels.shape}')
print(f'Unique clusters: {np.unique(labels)}')
print(f'Cluster distribution: {np.bincount(labels)}')

fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 4, figsize=(10, 10))
axes = axes.ravel()

for i in range(16):
    patch_idx = np.where(labels == i)[0]
    if len(patch_idx) > 0:
        representative_idx = patch_idx[0]
        patch = patches[representative_idx]
        axes[i].imshow(patch.astype('uint8'))
        axes[i].set_title(f'Cluster {i}')
    axes[i].axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('cluster_representatives.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

from sklearn.decomposition import NMF

nmf = NMF(n_components=20, init='random', random_state=42, max_iter=500)
patches_nmf = nmf.fit_transform(patches_reshaped)

print(f'NMF components shape: {nmf.components_.shape}')
print(f'Reconstruction error: {np.sum((patches_reshaped - nmf.transform(patches_reshaped) @ nmf.components_) ** 2):.2f}')

fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 5, figsize=(12, 10))
axes = axes.ravel()

for i in range(20):
    component = nmf.components_[i].reshape(10, 10, 3)
    component = (component - component.min()) / (component.max() - component.min())
    axes[i].imshow(component)
    axes[i].set_title(f'Component {i}')
    axes[i].axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('nmf_components.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

# KeyError: 'timestamp' - column name mismatch in sensor data ETL
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Generate sensor data
np.random.seed(42)
dates = pd.date_range('2024-01-01', periods=1000, freq='5min')
data = {
    'time': dates,
    'temperature': np.random.normal(22, 2, 1000),
    'humidity': np.random.normal(60, 10, 1000),
    'sensor_id': np.random.choice(['S001', 'S002', 'S003'], 1000)
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Bug: trying to access 'timestamp' which doesn't exist
df_sorted = df.sort_values('timestamp')
df_sorted['hour'] = df_sorted['timestamp'].dt.hour

# Step 1: Check actual column names
print(df.columns.tolist())
print(df.head())

# Step 2: Fix the column name reference
df_sorted = df.sort_values('time')
df_sorted['hour'] = df_sorted['time'].dt.hour
print(df_sorted.head())

# Step 3: Continue ETL - aggregate by hour and sensor
hourly_agg = df_sorted.groupby(['sensor_id', 'hour']).agg({
    'temperature': ['mean', 'std', 'min', 'max'],
    'humidity': ['mean', 'std']
}).reset_index()

hourly_agg.columns = ['_'.join(col).strip('_') for col in hourly_agg.columns.values]
print(hourly_agg.head(10))

# Step 4: Add derived features for anomaly detection
hourly_agg['temp_range'] = hourly_agg['temperature_max'] - hourly_agg['temperature_min']
hourly_agg['temp_std_zscore'] = np.abs((hourly_agg['temperature_std'] - hourly_agg['temperature_std'].mean()) / hourly_agg['temperature_std'].std())

# Flag potential anomalies
hourly_agg['is_anomaly'] = (hourly_agg['temp_std_zscore'] > 2) | (hourly_agg['temperature_std'] > 5)
print(f"\nAnomalies detected: {hourly_agg['is_anomaly'].sum()}")
print(hourly_agg[hourly_agg['is_anomaly']].head())

# Step 5: Save processed data with DuckDB for fast queries
import duckdb

conn = duckdb.connect(':memory:')
conn.register('sensor_hourly', hourly_agg)

# Query: average temperature by sensor
result = conn.execute('''
    SELECT sensor_id, 
           AVG(temperature_mean) as avg_temp,
           AVG(temperature_std) as avg_variability,
           COUNT(*) as readings
    FROM sensor_hourly
    GROUP BY sensor_id
    ORDER BY avg_variability DESC
''').df()

print(result)
print(f"\nETL pipeline completed. Processed {len(df_sorted)} raw sensor records into {len(hourly_agg)} hourly aggregates.")

    'feature1': np.random.randn(150),

        'data science and analytics',

        'reinforcement learning agents',
        'time series forecasting',
        'statistical inference methods',
        'cloud computing infrastructure'
    ]
})

con.execute('ALTER TABLE documents ADD COLUMN embedding DOUBLE[]')

        sensor_id,
        COUNT(*) as count,
        AVG(temperature) as avg_temp,
        STDDEV(temperature) as std_temp
    FROM sensor_data
    WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sensor_id
    ORDER BY sensor_id
""").pl()

    if len(sensor_data) > 2:
        z_scores = np.abs(stats.zscore(sensor_data))
        outliers = (z_scores > 2).sum()

import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage

# Create a synthetic image with objects
img = np.zeros((300, 400), dtype=np.uint8)
cv2.circle(img, (100, 100), 30, 255, -1)
cv2.circle(img, (250, 150), 25, 255, -1)
cv2.rectangle(img, (50, 200), (150, 280), 255, -1)

# Find contours and compute properties
contours, _ = cv2.findContours(img, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
print(f'Number of objects detected: {len(contours)}')

# Compute moments and centroids
for i, cnt in enumerate(contours):
    M = cv2.moments(cnt)
    if M['m00'] > 0:
        cx = int(M['m10'] / M['m00'])
        cy = int(M['m01'] / M['m00'])
        area = cv2.contourArea(cnt)
        perimeter = cv2.arcLength(cnt, True)
        circularity = 4 * np.pi * area / (perimeter ** 2)
        print(f'Object {i}: centroid=({cx},{cy}), area={area:.0f}, circularity={circularity:.3f}')

# Draw contours on image
img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_GRAY2RGB)
img_with_contours = cv2.drawContours(img_rgb.copy(), contours, -1, (0, 255, 0), 2)
Image.fromarray(img_with_contours).save('/tmp/contours.png')
print('Contour detection completed')

import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import networkx as nx
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Simulate pixel-level features from multiple image regions
np.random.seed(42)
n_regions = 50

df = pl.DataFrame({
    'region_id': range(n_regions),
    'avg_color_r': np.random.randint(0, 256, n_regions),
    'avg_color_g': np.random.randint(0, 256, n_regions),
    'avg_color_b': np.random.randint(0, 256, n_regions),
    'texture_entropy': np.random.uniform(0, 8, n_regions),
    'edge_magnitude': np.random.exponential(5, n_regions),
    'region_size': np.random.randint(100, 5000, n_regions),
})

# Cluster regions by visual similarity
features = df.select(['avg_color_r', 'avg_color_g', 'avg_color_b', 
                      'texture_entropy', 'edge_magnitude']).to_numpy()
scaler = StandardScaler()
features_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(features)

kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=5, random_state=42, n_init=10)
df = df.with_columns(pl.Series('cluster', kmeans.fit_predict(features_scaled)))

print("Region clustering results:")
print(df.group_by('cluster').agg(pl.col('region_id').count().alias('count')))

# Build adjacency graph based on feature similarity
G = nx.Graph()
for i in range(n_regions):
    G.add_node(i, cluster=df[i, 'cluster'])

# Connect regions with high similarity
for i in range(n_regions):
    for j in range(i + 1, n_regions):
        dist = np.linalg.norm(features_scaled[i] - features_scaled[j])
        if dist < 0.5:  # Similar regions
            G.add_edge(i, j, weight=1.0 / (1.0 + dist))

print(f"\nRegion connectivity graph:")
print(f"Nodes: {G.number_of_nodes()}, Edges: {G.number_of_edges()}")
print(f"Average degree: {2 * G.number_of_edges() / G.number_of_nodes():.2f}")

components = list(nx.connected_components(G))
print(f"Connected components: {len(components)}")
print(f"Largest component size: {max(len(c) for c in components)}")

import cv2
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Create synthetic image with multiple objects
img = np.zeros((300, 400, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
img[:, :] = (50, 50, 50)  # dark background

# Draw multiple objects
cv2.rectangle(img, (30, 30), (120, 120), (0, 255, 0), -1)
cv2.circle(img, (250, 80), 40, (255, 0, 0), -1)
cv2.circle(img, (180, 200), 35, (0, 0, 255), -1)
cv2.ellipse(img, (320, 180), (50, 30), 45, 0, 360, (255, 255, 0), -1)

# Convert to grayscale for processing
gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

# Find contours
contours, _ = cv2.findContours(gray, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)

# Extract features from contours
features = []
for cnt in contours:
    area = cv2.contourArea(cnt)
    perimeter = cv2.arcLength(cnt, True)
    circularity = (4 * np.pi * area) / (perimeter ** 2 + 1e-5) if perimeter > 0 else 0
    x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(cnt)
    aspect_ratio = w / (h + 1e-5)
    features.append([area, perimeter, circularity, aspect_ratio])

# Draw contours on image
img_contours = img.copy()
cv2.drawContours(img_contours, contours, -1, (0, 255, 255), 2)

# Plot
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
axes[0].imshow(img_rgb)
axes[0].set_title('Original Image')
axes[0].axis('off')

img_cont_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img_contours, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
axes[1].imshow(img_cont_rgb)
axes[1].set_title(f'Detected Contours ({len(contours)} objects)')
axes[1].axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('contour_detection.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f'Detected {len(contours)} objects')
print(f'Features shape: {np.array(features).shape}')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

np.random.seed(42)
n_users = 500
n_items = 200
sparsity = 0.95

user_ids = np.repeat(np.arange(n_users), int(n_items * (1 - sparsity)))
item_ids = np.tile(np.random.choice(n_items, int(n_items * (1 - sparsity)), replace=False), n_users)
ratings = np.random.randint(1, 6, size=len(user_ids))

df_ratings = pd.DataFrame({
    'user_id': user_ids,
    'item_id': item_ids,
    'rating': ratings
})
df_ratings = df_ratings.drop_duplicates()

print(f'Rating matrix shape: {len(df_ratings)} ratings')
print(f'Sparsity: {1 - len(df_ratings) / (n_users * n_items):.4f}')
print(df_ratings.head())

rating_matrix = df_ratings.pivot_table(
    index='user_id',
    columns='item_id',
    values='rating',
    fill_value=0
)

print(f'Rating matrix dimensions: {rating_matrix.shape}')
print(f'Mean rating: {rating_matrix[rating_matrix > 0].mean().mean():.2f}')
print(f'Non-zero entries: {(rating_matrix > 0).sum().sum()}')

svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=50, random_state=42, n_iter=100)
latent_factors_user = svd.fit_transform(rating_matrix)
latent_factors_item = svd.components_.T

print(f'User latent factors shape: {latent_factors_user.shape}')
print(f'Item latent factors shape: {latent_factors_item.shape}')
print(f'Explained variance ratio: {svd.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.4f}')

user_id_target = 10
user_vector = latent_factors_user[user_id_target:user_id_target+1]

similarity_scores = cosine_similarity(user_vector, latent_factors_item)[0]
recommended_items = np.argsort(similarity_scores)[::-1][:10]

df_recommendations = pd.DataFrame({
    'item_id': recommended_items,
    'similarity_score': similarity_scores[recommended_items]
})

print(f'Top 10 recommendations for user {user_id_target}:')
print(df_recommendations)

user_similarities = cosine_similarity(latent_factors_user)
np.fill_diagonal(user_similarities, 0)

neighbor_indices = np.argsort(user_similarities[user_id_target])[::-1][:5]
print(f'Top 5 similar users to user {user_id_target}:')
for i, neighbor_id in enumerate(neighbor_indices):
    print(f'{i+1}. User {neighbor_id} (similarity: {user_similarities[user_id_target, neighbor_id]:.4f})')

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

ax1 = axes[0]
variance_cumsum = np.cumsum(svd.explained_variance_ratio_)
ax1.plot(range(1, len(variance_cumsum) + 1), variance_cumsum, marker='o')
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Components')
ax1.set_ylabel('Cumulative Explained Variance')
ax1.set_title('SVD Dimensionality Reduction')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

ax2 = axes[1]
user_rating_counts = rating_matrix[rating_matrix > 0].sum(axis=1)
ax2.hist(user_rating_counts, bins=30, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Number of Ratings per User')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.set_title('User Activity Distribution')

plt.savefig('/tmp/recommendation_analysis.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Saved visualization to /tmp/recommendation_analysis.png')

def evaluate_coverage(recommendations_df, n_total_items):
    unique_items = recommendations_df['item_id'].nunique()
    coverage = unique_items / n_total_items
    return coverage

def evaluate_diversity(item_ids, item_factors):
    if len(item_ids) < 2:
        return 1.0
    similarities = cosine_similarity(item_factors[item_ids])
    np.fill_diagonal(similarities, 0)
    diversity = 1 - similarities.mean()
    return diversity

all_recommendations = []
for user_id in range(min(50, n_users)):
    user_vec = latent_factors_user[user_id:user_id+1]
    sim_scores = cosine_similarity(user_vec, latent_factors_item)[0]
    top_items = np.argsort(sim_scores)[::-1][:10]
    all_recommendations.extend(top_items)

coverage = evaluate_coverage(pd.DataFrame({'item_id': all_recommendations}), n_items)
diversity = evaluate_diversity(np.array(all_recommendations[:10]), latent_factors_item)

print(f'Catalog Coverage (top 50 users, top 10 items): {coverage:.4f}')
print(f'Recommendation Diversity (sample): {diversity:.4f}')

print(f"Sparsity: {(user_item_matrix == 0).sum().sum() / (user_item_matrix.shape[0] * user_item_matrix.shape[1]):.2%}")

df['rating'].describe().plot(kind='bar')
plt.title('Rating Distribution')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

ratings_per_user = df.groupby('user_id').size()
ratings_per_item = df.groupby('item_id').size()
print(f"\nAvg ratings per user: {ratings_per_user.mean():.2f}")
print(f"Avg ratings per item: {ratings_per_item.mean():.2f}")

from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD

U, s, Vt = np.linalg.svd(user_item_matrix.fillna(0), full_matrices=False)

k = 50
U_k = U[:, :k]
s_k = s[:k]
Vt_k = Vt[:k, :]

user_embeddings = U_k * np.sqrt(s_k)
item_embeddings = np.sqrt(s_k)[:, np.newaxis] * Vt_k

print(f"User embeddings shape: {user_embeddings.shape}")
print(f"Item embeddings shape: {item_embeddings.shape}")
print(f"\nUser embedding sample (first user, first 5 dims):")
print(user_embeddings[0, :5])

predictions = np.dot(user_embeddings, item_embeddings)
predictions_df = pd.DataFrame(
    predictions,
    index=user_item_matrix.index,
    columns=user_item_matrix.columns
)

print(f"Predictions shape: {predictions_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample predictions for user 0:")
print(predictions_df.iloc[0, :5])

train_df, test_df = train_test_split(df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

train_matrix = train_df.pivot_table(index='user_id', columns='item_id', values='rating', fill_value=0)
all_users = set(train_matrix.index)
all_items = set(train_matrix.columns)

mae_list = []
rmse_list = []

for _, row in test_df.iterrows():
    user_id = row['user_id']
    item_id = row['item_id']
    actual_rating = row['rating']
    
    if user_id in all_users and item_id in all_items:
        user_idx = list(train_matrix.index).index(user_id)
        item_idx = list(train_matrix.columns).index(item_id)
        pred_rating = predictions[user_idx, item_idx]
        
        mae_list.append(abs(actual_rating - pred_rating))
        rmse_list.append((actual_rating - pred_rating) ** 2)

mae = np.mean(mae_list)
rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean(rmse_list))

print(f"Mean Absolute Error: {mae:.4f}")
print(f"Root Mean Squared Error: {rmse:.4f}")
print(f"Predictions evaluated on {len(mae_list)} test samples")

def get_recommendations(user_id, n_recommendations=5):
    if user_id not in predictions_df.index:
        return None
    
    user_predictions = predictions_df.loc[user_id]
    user_rated_items = set(df[df['user_id'] == user_id]['item_id'])
    
    recommendations = user_predictions.drop(list(user_rated_items)).nlargest(n_recommendations)
    return recommendations

recommendations = get_recommendations(user_id=5, n_recommendations=10)
print(f"Top 10 recommendations for user 5:")
print(recommendations)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

np.random.seed(42)

products_data = {
    'product_id': range(1, 101),
    'name': [f'Product_{i}' for i in range(1, 101)],
    'description': [
        'high quality durable leather wallet' if i % 5 == 1 else
        'wireless bluetooth headphones sound' if i % 5 == 2 else
        'portable phone charger battery power' if i % 5 == 3 else
        'smart watch fitness tracker health' if i % 5 == 4 else
        'laptop backpack travel school bag'
        for i in range(100)
    ],
    'price': np.random.uniform(20, 500, 100),
    'avg_rating': np.random.uniform(3.5, 5.0, 100)
}

products_df = pd.DataFrame(products_data)

interactions_data = {
    'user_id': np.random.randint(1, 51, 500),
    'product_id': np.random.randint(1, 101, 500),
    'interaction_type': np.random.choice(['view', 'click', 'add_to_cart', 'purchase'], 500, p=[0.5, 0.2, 0.2, 0.1])
}

interactions_df = pd.DataFrame(interactions_data)
interactions_df = interactions_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['user_id', 'product_id']).reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Products: {len(products_df)}")
print(f"Interactions: {len(interactions_df)}")
print(f"\nInteraction types:")
print(interactions_df['interaction_type'].value_counts())

vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=50, stop_words='english')
product_vectors = vectorizer.fit_transform(products_df['description'])

product_similarity = cosine_similarity(product_vectors)
product_similarity_df = pd.DataFrame(
    product_similarity,
    index=products_df['product_id'],
    columns=products_df['product_id']
)

print(f"Product similarity matrix shape: {product_similarity_df.shape}")
print(f"\nSimilarity between product 1 and products 1-5:")
print(product_similarity_df.iloc[0, :5])

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(product_similarity_df.iloc[:10, :10], cmap='coolwarm', center=0, square=True)
plt.title('Content Similarity Matrix (First 10 Products)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

interaction_weights = {
    'view': 1,
    'click': 2,
    'add_to_cart': 3,
    'purchase': 5
}

interactions_df['weight'] = interactions_df['interaction_type'].map(interaction_weights)

user_product_scores = interactions_df.groupby(['user_id', 'product_id'])['weight'].sum().reset_index()
user_product_scores.columns = ['user_id', 'product_id', 'score']

scaler = MinMaxScaler()
user_product_scores['normalized_score'] = scaler.fit_transform(user_product_scores[['score']])

print(f"User-product scores: {len(user_product_scores)}")
print(user_product_scores.head(10))
print(f"\nScore distribution:")
user_product_scores['score'].describe()

def hybrid_recommendations(user_id, n_recommendations=5):
    user_interactions = user_product_scores[user_product_scores['user_id'] == user_id].sort_values('score', ascending=False)
    
    if len(user_interactions) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    
    interacted_products = user_interactions['product_id'].values[:3]
    
    candidate_products = set()
    for prod_id in interacted_products:
        similar = product_similarity_df[prod_id].sort_values(ascending=False).head(10).index
        candidate_products.update(similar)
    
    candidate_products = candidate_products - set(interacted_products)
    
    candidate_scores = []
    for prod_id in candidate_products:
        base_score = products_df[products_df['product_id'] == prod_id]['avg_rating'].values[0]
        similarity_score = product_similarity_df.loc[prod_id, interacted_products].mean()
        hybrid_score = 0.4 * similarity_score + 0.6 * (base_score / 5.0)
        candidate_scores.append({
            'product_id': prod_id,
            'hybrid_score': hybrid_score
        })
    
    recommendations = pd.DataFrame(candidate_scores).sort_values('hybrid_score', ascending=False).head(n_recommendations)
    recommendations = recommendations.merge(
        products_df[['product_id', 'name', 'price', 'avg_rating']],
        on='product_id'
    )
    
    return recommendations

hybrid_rec = hybrid_recommendations(user_id=1, n_recommendations=5)
print(f"\nHybrid recommendations for user 1:")
print(hybrid_rec)

from sklearn.metrics import ndcg_score

test_users = interactions_df['user_id'].unique()[:10]
metrics = []

for user_id in test_users:
    user_interactions = interactions_df[interactions_df['user_id'] == user_id]
    ground_truth = user_interactions['product_id'].values
    
    hybrid_recs = hybrid_recommendations(user_id=user_id, n_recommendations=10)
    if len(hybrid_recs) > 0:
        rec_products = hybrid_recs['product_id'].values
        
        y_true = [1 if p in ground_truth else 0 for p in rec_products]
        y_score = hybrid_recs['hybrid_score'].values
        
        if sum(y_true) > 0:
            ndcg = ndcg_score([y_true], [y_score])
            metrics.append({
                'user_id': user_id,
                'ndcg': ndcg,
                'recommendations': len(rec_products)
            })

metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(metrics)
print(f"\nRecommendation Quality Metrics:")
print(metrics_df)
if len(metrics_df) > 0:
    print(f"\nAverage NDCG@10: {metrics_df['ndcg'].mean():.4f}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from datasets import load_dataset
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

ds = load_dataset('ag_news')
df = pd.DataFrame(ds['train']).head(500)
df['text'] = df['text'].fillna('')
print(df.head())
print(df.shape)

vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=1000, stop_words='english', min_df=2)
tfidf_matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(df['text'])
print(f'TF-IDF matrix shape: {tfidf_matrix.shape}')
print(f'Vocabulary size: {len(vectorizer.get_feature_names_out())}')

def content_based_recommender(item_idx, n_recommendations=5):
    similarities = cosine_similarity(tfidf_matrix[item_idx], tfidf_matrix).flatten()
    similar_indices = np.argsort(-similarities)[1:n_recommendations+1]
    return df.iloc[similar_indices][['text', 'label']].copy()

query_idx = 42
print(f'Query article (idx {query_idx}):')
print(df.iloc[query_idx]['text'][:200])
print('\nTop 5 recommendations:')
recommendations = content_based_recommender(query_idx, n_recommendations=5)
for i, row in recommendations.iterrows():
    print(f"  - {row['text'][:100]}...")

import polars as pl
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

user_item_interactions = np.random.choice([0, 1], size=(100, 500), p=[0.95, 0.05])
user_scores = np.random.rand(100, 500)
user_scores[user_item_interactions == 0] = 0

interaction_df = pl.DataFrame({
    'user_id': np.repeat(np.arange(100), 500),
    'item_id': np.tile(np.arange(500), 100),
    'score': user_scores.flatten()
}).filter(pl.col('score') > 0)

print(f'Total interactions: {interaction_df.shape[0]}')
print(f'Sparsity: {1 - interaction_df.shape[0] / (100 * 500):.2%}')

from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD

user_item_sparse = csr_matrix((interaction_df['score'].to_numpy(), 
                                (interaction_df['user_id'].to_numpy(), 
                                 interaction_df['item_id'].to_numpy())), 
                               shape=(100, 500))

svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=50, random_state=42, n_iter=100)
latent_factors = svd.fit_transform(user_item_sparse)
print(f'Latent factors shape: {latent_factors.shape}')
print(f'Explained variance: {svd.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.2%}')

def collaborative_filtering_recommend(user_idx, n_recommendations=5):
    user_latent = latent_factors[user_idx]
    item_latent = svd.components_.T
    scores = np.dot(user_latent, item_latent.T)
    
    user_items = set(interaction_df.filter(pl.col('user_id') == user_idx)['item_id'].to_numpy())
    recommended_indices = np.argsort(-scores)
    recommended_indices = [i for i in recommended_indices if i not in user_items][:n_recommendations]
    
    return df.iloc[recommended_indices][['text', 'label']].copy()

user_id = 15
print(f'Collaborative filtering recommendations for user {user_id}:')
cf_recommendations = collaborative_filtering_recommend(user_id, n_recommendations=5)
for i, row in cf_recommendations.iterrows():
    print(f"  - {row['text'][:100]}...")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

ax1 = axes[0]
ax1.plot(np.cumsum(svd.explained_variance_ratio_))
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Components')
ax1.set_ylabel('Cumulative Explained Variance')
ax1.set_title('SVD Variance Explained')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

ax2 = axes[1]
interaction_summary = interaction_df.group_by('user_id').agg(pl.col('score').count().alias('interactions')).to_pandas()

ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.set_title('User Interaction Distribution')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('recommender_analysis.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
print('Analysis plot saved')

import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

np.random.seed(42)

image_data = []
for i in range(50):
    img_array = np.random.randint(0, 256, (100, 100, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    image_data.append({'image_id': i, 'array': img_array})

print(f'Created {len(image_data)} sample images')
print(f'Each image shape: {image_data[0]["array"].shape}')

def extract_image_features(img_array):
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img_array, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
    hist = cv2.calcHist([gray], [0], None, [256], [0, 256]).flatten()
    hist = hist / (hist.sum() + 1e-8)
    
    corners = cv2.goodFeaturesToTrack(gray, maxCorners=100, qualityLevel=0.01, minDistance=10)
    n_corners = len(corners) if corners is not None else 0
    
    edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 100, 200)
    edge_density = np.sum(edges > 0) / edges.size
    
    mean_val = np.mean(gray)
    std_val = np.std(gray)
    
    features = np.concatenate([
        hist[:32],
        [n_corners, edge_density, mean_val, std_val]
    ])
    return features

feature_list = []
for item in image_data:
    features = extract_image_features(item['array'])
    feature_list.append(features)

feature_matrix = np.array(feature_list)
print(f'Feature matrix shape: {feature_matrix.shape}')
print(f'Features per image: {feature_matrix.shape[1]}')

scaler = StandardScaler()
features_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(feature_matrix)

kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=5, random_state=42, n_init=10)
clusters = kmeans.fit_predict(features_scaled)

cluster_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'image_id': range(50),
    'cluster': clusters
})

print('\nCluster distribution:')
print(cluster_df['cluster'].value_counts().sort_index())

def content_based_image_recommender(query_image_id, n_recommendations=5):
    query_features = features_scaled[query_image_id]
    distances = np.linalg.norm(features_scaled - query_features, axis=1)
    
    similar_indices = np.argsort(distances)[1:n_recommendations+1]
    return cluster_df.iloc[similar_indices].copy()

query_id = 10
print(f'\nRecommendations for image {query_id} (cluster {cluster_df.loc[query_id, "cluster"]}):' )
recs = content_based_image_recommender(query_id, n_recommendations=5)
print(recs.to_string())

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

pca = PCA(n_components=2)
features_2d = pca.fit_transform(features_scaled)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
scatter = ax.scatter(features_2d[:, 0], features_2d[:, 1], c=clusters, cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax.scatter(features_2d[query_id, 0], features_2d[query_id, 1], c='red', s=300, marker='*', 
           label=f'Query (ID {query_id})', edgecolors='darkred', linewidth=2)

rec_indices = content_based_image_recommender(query_id, n_recommendations=5)['image_id'].values
ax.scatter(features_2d[rec_indices, 0], features_2d[rec_indices, 1], c='orange', s=150, 
           marker='s', label='Recommendations', alpha=0.6, edgecolors='darkorange', linewidth=2)

ax.set_xlabel(f'PC1 ({pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]:.1%})')
ax.set_ylabel(f'PC2 ({pca.explained_variance_ratio_[1]:.1%})')
ax.set_title('Image Embeddings (PCA Projection)')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('image_recommender.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
print('Image recommender visualization saved')

import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from xgboost import XGBRanker
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

np.random.seed(42)

user_ids = np.repeat(np.arange(100), 50)
item_ids = np.tile(np.arange(500), 100)[:len(user_ids)]
clicks = np.random.binomial(1, 0.15, len(user_ids))
views = np.ones(len(user_ids)) + np.random.poisson(2, len(user_ids))
time_on_page = views * np.random.exponential(5, len(user_ids))
item_age_days = np.random.exponential(30, len(user_ids))
user_activity = np.repeat(np.random.exponential(100, 100), 50)

interaction_data = pl.DataFrame({
    'user_id': user_ids,
    'item_id': item_ids,
    'clicked': clicks,
    'views': views.astype(int),
    'time_on_page': time_on_page,
    'item_age_days': item_age_days,
    'user_activity_score': user_activity
})

print(f'Dataset shape: {interaction_data.shape}')
print(f'Click rate: {interaction_data["clicked"].mean():.2%}')
print(interaction_data.head())

interaction_pd = interaction_data.to_pandas()

features = ['views', 'time_on_page', 'item_age_days', 'user_activity_score']
X = interaction_pd[features].values
y = interaction_pd['clicked'].values

group_sizes = interaction_pd.groupby('user_id').size().values

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

print(f'Feature matrix shape: {X_scaled.shape}')
print(f'Number of user groups: {len(group_sizes)}')
print(f'Group sizes (first 10): {group_sizes[:10]}')

ranker = XGBRanker(
    n_estimators=50,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    objective='binary:logistic',
    random_state=42,
    tree_method='hist'
)

ranker.fit(
    X_scaled, y,
    group=group_sizes,
    verbose=False
)

print('XGBoost Ranker trained successfully')

def rank_items_for_user(user_id, n_recommendations=5):
    user_items = interaction_pd[interaction_pd['user_id'] == user_id].copy()
    
    if len(user_items) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    
    user_X = user_items[features].values
    user_X_scaled = scaler.transform(user_X)
    
    scores = ranker.predict(user_X_scaled)
    user_items['predicted_score'] = scores
    user_items_sorted = user_items.sort_values('predicted_score', ascending=False)
    
    return user_items_sorted[['item_id', 'predicted_score', 'clicked', 'views']].head(n_recommendations)

user_to_rank = 15
print(f'\nTop recommendations for user {user_to_rank}:')
recommendations = rank_items_for_user(user_to_rank, n_recommendations=5)
print(recommendations.to_string())

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import ndcg_score, mean_average_precision_score

user_groups = interaction_pd['user_id'].unique()
train_users, test_users = train_test_split(user_groups, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

train_mask = interaction_pd['user_id'].isin(train_users)
test_mask = interaction_pd['user_id'].isin(test_users)

X_train = X_scaled[train_mask]
y_train = y[train_mask]
group_train = interaction_pd[train_mask].groupby('user_id').size().values

X_test = X_scaled[test_mask]
y_test = y[test_mask]
group_test = interaction_pd[test_mask].groupby('user_id').size().values

ranker_eval = XGBRanker(
    n_estimators=50,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    objective='binary:logistic',
    random_state=42,
    tree_method='hist'
)

ranker_eval.fit(X_train, y_train, group=group_train, verbose=False)

y_pred = ranker_eval.predict(X_test)

test_data = interaction_pd[test_mask].copy()
test_data['pred_score'] = y_pred

ndcg_scores = []
for user_id in test_users:
    user_mask = test_data['user_id'] == user_id
    if user_mask.sum() > 0:
        y_true = test_data.loc[user_mask, 'clicked'].values
        y_pred_user = test_data.loc[user_mask, 'pred_score'].values
        if len(y_true) > 0 and y_true.sum() > 0:
            ndcg = ndcg_score([y_true], [y_pred_user])
            ndcg_scores.append(ndcg)

print(f'\nEvaluation Results:')
print(f'Mean NDCG@5: {np.mean(ndcg_scores):.4f}')
print(f'NDCG Std Dev: {np.std(ndcg_scores):.4f}')
print(f'Click accuracy on test set: {(y_pred.round() == y_test).mean():.2%}')

feature_importance = ranker_eval.feature_importances_
feature_names = features

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
indices = np.argsort(feature_importance)[::-1]
ax.barh(range(len(feature_importance)), feature_importance[indices], edgecolor='black')
ax.set_yticks(range(len(feature_importance)))
ax.set_yticklabels([feature_names[i] for i in indices])
ax.set_xlabel('Feature Importance (Gain)')
ax.set_title('XGBoost Ranker Feature Importance')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('ranker_importance.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print('\nFeature importance plot saved')
print('\nFeature Importance:')
for name, imp in sorted(zip(feature_names, feature_importance), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
    print(f'  {name}: {imp:.4f}')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, ndcg_score
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

np.random.seed(42)
n_users = 1000
n_items = 500
n_interactions = 50000

user_ids = np.random.randint(0, n_users, n_interactions)
item_ids = np.random.randint(0, n_items, n_interactions)
ratings = np.random.randint(1, 6, n_interactions)
timestamps = pd.date_range('2024-01-01', periods=n_interactions, freq='10min')
user_age = np.random.randint(18, 80, n_users)
item_category = np.random.choice(['electronics', 'books', 'clothing', 'home', 'sports'], n_items)

df = pd.DataFrame({
    'user_id': user_ids,
    'item_id': item_ids,
    'rating': ratings,
    'timestamp': timestamps,
    'hour_of_day': timestamps.hour,
    'day_of_week': timestamps.dayofweek
})

user_features = pd.DataFrame({
    'user_id': range(n_users),
    'age': user_age,
    'age_group': pd.cut(user_age, bins=[0, 25, 40, 60, 100], labels=['young', 'adult', 'middle', 'senior'])
})

item_features = pd.DataFrame({
    'item_id': range(n_items),
    'category': np.random.choice(['electronics', 'books', 'clothing', 'home', 'sports'], n_items),
    'popularity': np.random.uniform(0, 1, n_items)
})

df = df.merge(user_features, on='user_id', how='left')
df = df.merge(item_features, on='item_id', how='left')

print(f"Dataset shape: {df.shape}")
print(df.head())
print(f"Rating distribution:\n{df['rating'].value_counts().sort_index()}")

le_category = LabelEncoder()
df['category_encoded'] = le_category.fit_transform(df['category'])
df['age_group_encoded'] = pd.Categorical(df['age_group'], categories=['young', 'adult', 'middle', 'senior']).codes

feature_cols = ['user_id', 'item_id', 'hour_of_day', 'day_of_week', 'age', 'category_encoded', 'popularity', 'age_group_encoded']
X = df[feature_cols].copy()
y = df['rating'].copy()

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
X_df = pd.DataFrame(X_scaled, columns=feature_cols)

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X_df, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

print(f"Training set size: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"Test set size: {X_test.shape}")
print(f"Feature columns: {feature_cols}")

train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, feature_names=feature_cols)
test_data = lgb.Dataset(X_test, label=y_test, feature_names=feature_cols, reference=train_data)

params = {
    'objective': 'regression',
    'metric': 'rmse',
    'num_leaves': 31,
    'learning_rate': 0.05,
    'feature_fraction': 0.8,
    'bagging_fraction': 0.8,
    'bagging_freq': 5,
    'verbose': -1
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=100,
    valid_sets=[test_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(10)]
)

y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred))
print(f"Test RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

feature_importance = pd.DataFrame({
    'feature': feature_cols,
    'importance': model.feature_importance()
}).sort_values('importance', ascending=False)

print("\nFeature Importance:")
print(feature_importance)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.barh(feature_importance['feature'], feature_importance['importance'])
plt.xlabel('Importance')
plt.title('LightGBM Feature Importance for Rating Prediction')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('feature_importance.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

sns.set_style('whitegrid')
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))

axes[0, 0].hist(df['rating'], bins=5, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Rating Distribution')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Rating')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Count')

df.groupby('hour_of_day')['rating'].mean().plot(ax=axes[0, 1], marker='o')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Average Rating by Hour of Day')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Hour')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Avg Rating')

df.groupby('age_group')['rating'].mean().plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 0], color='skyblue')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Rating by Age Group')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Age Group')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Avg Rating')
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

df.groupby('category')['rating'].mean().plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], color='coral')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Rating by Category')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Category')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Avg Rating')
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('rating_analysis.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print("Visualizations saved.")

user_item_matrix = df.pivot_table(index='user_id', columns='item_id', values='rating', fill_value=0)
print(f"User-Item matrix shape: {user_item_matrix.shape}")
print(f"Sparsity: {(user_item_matrix == 0).sum().sum() / (user_item_matrix.shape[0] * user_item_matrix.shape[1]):.2%}")

user_stats = df.groupby('user_id').agg({
    'rating': ['count', 'mean', 'std'],
    'age': 'first'
}).round(3)
user_stats.columns = ['interaction_count', 'mean_rating', 'rating_std', 'age']
user_stats = user_stats.sort_values('interaction_count', ascending=False)

print("\nTop users by interaction count:")
print(user_stats.head(10))

    'popularity': 'first'
}).round(3)

print("\nTop items by rating count:")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from implicit.als import AlternatingLeastSquares
from implicit.evaluation import mean_average_precision
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

np.random.seed(42)
n_users, n_items = 500, 300
n_interactions = 8000

user_ids = np.random.randint(0, n_users, n_interactions)
item_ids = np.random.randint(0, n_items, n_interactions)
ratings = np.random.choice([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], n_interactions, p=[0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.25])

df = pd.DataFrame({
    'user_id': user_ids,
    'item_id': item_ids,
    'rating': ratings
})
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['user_id', 'item_id'], keep='last')
print(f'Interactions shape: {df.shape}')
print(df.head())

interaction_matrix = csr_matrix((
    df['rating'],
    (df['user_id'], df['item_id'])
), shape=(n_users, n_items))

print(f'Sparse matrix density: {interaction_matrix.nnz / (n_users * n_items):.4f}')
print(f'Average interactions per user: {df.groupby("user_id").size().mean():.2f}')
print(f'Average interactions per item: {df.groupby("item_id").size().mean():.2f}')

model = AlternatingLeastSquares(
    factors=50,
    regularization=0.05,
    iterations=20,
    calculate_training_loss=True,
    random_state=42,
    use_gpu=False
)

model.fit(interaction_matrix, show_progress=False)
print('ALS model trained successfully')
print(f'Training loss history: {model.calculate_training_loss}')

train_size = int(0.8 * len(df))
train_df = df.iloc[:train_size]
test_df = df.iloc[train_size:]

train_matrix = csr_matrix((
    train_df['rating'],
    (train_df['user_id'], train_df['item_id'])
), shape=(n_users, n_items))

model_eval = AlternatingLeastSquares(
    factors=50,
    regularization=0.05,
    iterations=20,
    random_state=42,
    use_gpu=False
)
model_eval.fit(train_matrix, show_progress=False)

test_matrix = csr_matrix((
    test_df['rating'],
    (test_df['user_id'], test_df['item_id'])
), shape=(n_users, n_items))

map_score = mean_average_precision(
    model_eval,
    train_matrix,
    test_matrix,
    num_threads=1
)
print(f'Mean Average Precision on test set: {map_score:.4f}')

sample_user = 10
user_items = train_matrix[sample_user].nonzero()[1]
user_ratings = train_matrix[sample_user].data

recommendations = model_eval.recommend(
    sample_user,
    train_matrix[sample_user],
    N=10,
    filter_already_liked_items=True
)

rec_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'item_id': [r[0] for r in recommendations],
    'score': [r[1] for r in recommendations]
})

print(f'User {sample_user} interaction history:')
print(f'  Liked {len(user_items)} items')
print(f'\nTop 10 recommendations:')
print(rec_df)

user_factors = model_eval.user_factors
item_factors = model_eval.item_factors

from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

user_similarity = cosine_similarity(user_factors)
item_similarity = cosine_similarity(item_factors)

print(f'User factor matrix shape: {user_factors.shape}')
print(f'Item factor matrix shape: {item_factors.shape}')
print(f'User similarity mean: {np.mean(user_similarity):.4f}')
print(f'Item similarity mean: {np.mean(item_similarity):.4f}')

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))

user_interaction_counts = df.groupby('user_id').size()
axes[0, 0].hist(user_interaction_counts, bins=30, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Interactions per User')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 0].set_title('User Activity Distribution')

item_interaction_counts = df.groupby('item_id').size()
axes[0, 1].hist(item_interaction_counts, bins=30, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Interactions per Item')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Item Popularity Distribution')

rating_dist = df['rating'].value_counts().sort_index()
axes[1, 0].bar(rating_dist.index, rating_dist.values, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Rating')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Rating Distribution')

user_similarity_diag = user_similarity[np.triu_indices_from(user_similarity, k=1)]
axes[1, 1].hist(user_similarity_diag, bins=50, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Cosine Similarity')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[1, 1].set_title('User Factor Similarity Distribution')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('als_analysis.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('Visualization saved')

import polars as pl
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

np.random.seed(42)

n_sessions = 5000
n_items = 200
data = []

for session_id in range(n_sessions):
    session_length = np.random.randint(2, 15)
    items = np.random.choice(n_items, session_length, replace=False)
    timestamps = np.sort(np.random.uniform(0, 3600, session_length))
    for idx, (item, ts) in enumerate(zip(items, timestamps)):
        data.append({
            'session_id': session_id,
            'item_id': int(item),
            'position': idx,
            'timestamp': float(ts),
            'dwell_time': float(np.random.exponential(5))  # seconds
        })

df_pl = pl.DataFrame(data)
print(f'Total events: {len(df_pl)}')
print(df_pl.head(10))

session_features = df_pl.group_by('session_id').agg([
    pl.col('item_id').count().alias('session_length'),
    pl.col('dwell_time').sum().alias('total_dwell'),
    pl.col('dwell_time').mean().alias('avg_dwell'),
    pl.col('timestamp').max().alias('session_duration'),
    (pl.col('item_id').max() - pl.col('item_id').min()).alias('item_range')
])

print('\nSession-level features:')
print(session_features.head())
print(f'\nSession statistics:')
print(session_features.describe())

item_features = df_pl.group_by('item_id').agg([
    pl.col('session_id').n_unique().alias('num_sessions'),
    pl.col('position').mean().alias('avg_position'),
    pl.col('dwell_time').mean().alias('avg_dwell_time'),
    pl.col('session_id').count().alias('total_clicks')
])

print('\nItem-level features:')
print(item_features.head(10))
print(f'\nItem statistics:')
print(item_features.describe())

session_item_data = df_pl.select(['session_id', 'item_id']).to_pandas()
session_item_matrix = csr_matrix((
    np.ones(len(session_item_data)),
    (session_item_data['session_id'], session_item_data['item_id'])
), shape=(n_sessions, n_items))

svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=15, random_state=42, n_iter=100)
session_embeddings = svd.fit_transform(session_item_matrix)
item_embeddings = svd.components_.T

print(f'Session embeddings shape: {session_embeddings.shape}')
print(f'Item embeddings shape: {item_embeddings.shape}')
print(f'Explained variance ratio: {svd.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.4f}')
print(f'Top 5 variance explained: {svd.explained_variance_ratio_[:5]}')

from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

session_sim = cosine_similarity(session_embeddings)
item_sim = cosine_similarity(item_embeddings)

print(f'Average session-to-session similarity: {np.mean(session_sim[np.triu_indices_from(session_sim, k=1)]):.4f}')
print(f'Average item-to-item similarity: {np.mean(item_sim[np.triu_indices_from(item_sim, k=1)]):.4f}')

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

session_lens = session_features['session_length'].to_numpy()
axes[0, 0].hist(session_lens, bins=30, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7, color='steelblue')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Session Length')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Distribution of Session Lengths')

avg_dwells = session_features['avg_dwell'].to_numpy()
axes[0, 1].hist(avg_dwells, bins=30, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7, color='coral')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Average Dwell Time (seconds)')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Average Dwell Time per Session')

var_explained = np.cumsum(svd.explained_variance_ratio_)
axes[1, 0].plot(range(1, len(var_explained) + 1), var_explained, marker='o', linewidth=2)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Number of Components')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Cumulative Explained Variance')
axes[1, 0].set_title('SVD Variance Explained')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

item_popularity = item_features['total_clicks'].to_numpy()
axes[1, 1].hist(item_popularity, bins=40, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7, color='green')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Total Clicks')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Items')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Item Popularity Distribution')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('session_analysis.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('Visualization saved')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import networkx as nx
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

np.random.seed(42)
n_interactions = 20000

interactions = {
    'user_id': np.random.randint(1, 201, n_interactions),
    'item_id': np.random.randint(1, 101, n_interactions),
    'rating': np.random.choice([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], n_interactions, p=[0.1, 0.15, 0.25, 0.3, 0.2]),
    'timestamp': pd.date_range('2023-01-01', periods=n_interactions, freq='30min')
}

df_interactions = pd.DataFrame(interactions)
print(f"User-Item interactions: {df_interactions.shape[0]}")
print(df_interactions.describe())

from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

user_item_matrix = df_interactions.pivot_table(
    index='user_id',
    columns='item_id',
    values='rating',
    fill_value=0,
    aggfunc='mean'
)

user_similarity = cosine_similarity(user_item_matrix)
user_sim_df = pd.DataFrame(
    user_similarity,
    index=user_item_matrix.index,
    columns=user_item_matrix.index
)

print(f"\nUser similarity matrix shape: {user_sim_df.shape}")
print(f"Average user similarity: {user_similarity[np.triu_indices_from(user_similarity, k=1)].mean():.4f}")

G = nx.Graph()

for _, row in df_interactions.iterrows():
    user = f"U{row['user_id']}"
    item = f"I{row['item_id']}"
    weight = row['rating'] / 5.0
    G.add_edge(user, item, weight=weight, rating=row['rating'])

print(f"\nNetwork Graph:")
print(f"  Nodes: {G.number_of_nodes()}")
print(f"  Edges: {G.number_of_edges()}")

user_degree = {node: G.degree(node, weight='weight') for node in G if node.startswith('U')}
item_degree = {node: G.degree(node, weight='weight') for node in G if node.startswith('I')}

top_users_degree = sorted(user_degree.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]
top_items_degree = sorted(item_degree.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]

print(f"\nTop 5 Users by Weighted Degree (engagement):")
for user, degree in top_users_degree:
    print(f"  {user}: {degree:.4f}")

print(f"\nTop 5 Items by Weighted Degree (popularity):")
for item, degree in top_items_degree:
    print(f"  {item}: {degree:.4f}")

from sklearn.decomposition import NMF

from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix as sparse_csr

user_item_sparse = sparse_csr(user_item_matrix.values)

n_factors = 15
nmf_model = NMF(
    n_components=n_factors,
    init='nndsvda',
    random_state=42,
    max_iter=200,
    alpha_W=0.01,
    alpha_H=0.01
)

W = nmf_model.fit_transform(user_item_sparse)
H = nmf_model.components_

reconstructed = W @ H
rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((user_item_sparse.toarray() - reconstructed) ** 2))
print(f"\nNMF Reconstruction RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")
print(f"User factor matrix shape: {W.shape}")
print(f"Item factor matrix shape: {H.shape}")

def nmf_recommend(user_id, W, H, user_item_matrix, top_n=5):
    user_idx = list(user_item_matrix.index).index(user_id)
    user_factors = W[user_idx]
    
    item_scores = user_factors @ H
    
    user_rated = set(user_item_matrix.loc[user_id][user_item_matrix.loc[user_id] > 0].index)
    
    recommendations = []
    for item_idx, score in enumerate(item_scores):
        item_id = user_item_matrix.columns[item_idx]
        if item_id not in user_rated:
            recommendations.append((item_id, score))
    
    return sorted(recommendations, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:top_n]

nmf_recs = nmf_recommend(test_user, W, H, user_item_matrix)

# Create a simple CNN for MNIST instead of ResNet (ResNet expects 3 channels)
class SimpleCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(SimpleCNN, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(1, 32, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(64 * 7 * 7, 128)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 10)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2, 2)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.pool(self.relu(self.conv1(x)))
        x = self.pool(self.relu(self.conv2(x)))
        x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
        x = self.relu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.fc2(x)
        return x

import numpy as np

from scipy import signal

n_samples = 1000
n_channels = 4

# Create multivariate sensor readings
data_dict = {'timestamp': pd.date_range('2024-01-01', periods=n_samples, freq='1s')}
for i in range(n_channels):
    data_dict[f'sensor_{i}'] = 100 + 5 * np.sin(np.linspace(0, 10*np.pi, n_samples)) + np.random.randn(n_samples) * 0.5

df = pd.DataFrame(data_dict)
print(f"Original shape: {df.shape}")
print(df.head())

# Try to apply filter with incompatible shapes
b, a = signal.butter(2, 0.1)
filtered = signal.filtfilt(b, a, df[['sensor_0', 'sensor_1']])  # Wrong: 2D array
df['sensor_0_filtered'] = filtered
print(df.head())

# Fix: process each channel independently
filtered_data = {}
for i in range(n_channels):
    col_name = f'sensor_{i}'
    filtered_data[f'{col_name}_filtered'] = signal.filtfilt(b, a, df[col_name].values)

df_filtered = pd.concat([df, pd.DataFrame(filtered_data)], axis=1)
print(f"Filtered shape: {df_filtered.shape}")
print(df_filtered.head())

# Store in DuckDB and compute anomaly detection statistics

conn.register('sensors', df_filtered)

# Calculate rolling statistics using DuckDB
query = """
SELECT 
    timestamp,
    sensor_0,
    sensor_0_filtered,
    AVG(sensor_0_filtered) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_mean_20,

import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Generate time series data
date_range = pd.date_range(start='2024-01-01', periods=1000, freq='H')
data = {
    'timestamp': date_range,
    'value': np.cumsum(np.random.randn(1000)) + 100,
    'category': np.random.choice(['A', 'B', 'C'], 1000),
    'metric_type': np.random.choice(['sales', 'clicks', 'impressions'], 1000)
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create DuckDB connection and query with SQL
conn = duckdb.connect(':memory:')
conn.register('metrics', df)

# Complex aggregation query
result = conn.execute("""
    SELECT 
        category,
        metric_type,
        DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp) as date,
        COUNT(*) as count,
        AVG(value) as avg_value,
        MAX(value) as max_value,
        MIN(value) as min_value,
        STDDEV(value) as stddev_value
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY category, metric_type, DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp)
    ORDER BY date DESC, category, metric_type
""").fetchall()

result_df = pd.DataFrame(
    result,
    columns=['category', 'metric_type', 'date', 'count', 'avg_value', 'max_value', 'min_value', 'stddev_value']
)

print(f"Aggregated {len(df)} rows into {len(result_df)} result groups")
print(result_df.head(10))

# Another query: identify anomalies (values > 2 std devs from mean)
anomalies = conn.execute("""
    WITH stats AS (
        SELECT category, AVG(value) as mean_val, STDDEV(value) as std_val
        FROM metrics
        GROUP BY category
    )
    SELECT m.timestamp, m.category, m.value, s.mean_val, s.std_val,
           (m.value - s.mean_val) / s.std_val as z_score
    FROM metrics m
    JOIN stats s ON m.category = s.category
    WHERE ABS((m.value - s.mean_val) / s.std_val) > 2
    ORDER BY z_score DESC
""").fetchall()

print(f"\nFound {len(anomalies)} anomalies")

from sklearn.decomposition import LatentDirichletAllocation
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Sample document corpus
documents = [
    "Python is great for data science and machine learning applications.",
    "Machine learning models require lots of data for training.",
    "Deep learning uses neural networks for complex pattern recognition.",
    "Data scientists use Python libraries like pandas and scikit-learn.",
    "Natural language processing analyzes text and language patterns.",
    "Neural networks are inspired by the human brain.",
    "Data preprocessing is crucial for model performance.",
    "Python's flexibility makes it perfect for AI research."
]

# TF-IDF Vectorization
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=20, stop_words='english')
tfidf_matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(documents)

# Topic modeling with LDA
lda = LatentDirichletAllocation(n_components=2, random_state=42, max_iter=10)
lda.fit(tfidf_matrix)

# Display top words per topic
feature_names = vectorizer.get_feature_names_out()
for topic_idx, topic in enumerate(lda.components_):
    top_words_idx = topic.argsort()[-5:][::-1]
    top_words = [feature_names[i] for i in top_words_idx]
    print(f'Topic {topic_idx}: {" ".join(top_words)}')

# Document-topic distribution
doc_topics = lda.transform(tfidf_matrix)
df_topics = pd.DataFrame(doc_topics, columns=['Topic 0', 'Topic 1'])
df_topics['Document'] = [f'Doc {i}' for i in range(len(documents))]

print('\nDocument-Topic Distribution:')
print(df_topics)

import numpy as np

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.covariance import EllipticEnvelope
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, classification_report

# Create synthetic time-series sensor data with anomalies
np.random.seed(42)
time_steps = 500
normal_data = np.random.normal(loc=20, scale=2, size=(time_steps, 3))
anomalies_idx = np.random.choice(time_steps, 25, replace=False)
normal_data[anomalies_idx] += np.random.uniform(10, 15, size=(25, 3))

df = pd.DataFrame(normal_data, columns=['sensor_1', 'sensor_2', 'sensor_3'])
df['is_anomaly'] = 0
df.loc[anomalies_idx, 'is_anomaly'] = 1

# Prepare features and labels
X = df[['sensor_1', 'sensor_2', 'sensor_3']].values
y_true = df['is_anomaly'].values

# Standardize
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# Apply Robust Covariance (Minimum Covariance Determinant)
robust_cov = EllipticEnvelope(contamination=0.05, random_state=42)
predictions = robust_cov.fit_predict(X_scaled)
y_pred = (predictions == -1).astype(int)

# Evaluate
print('Confusion Matrix:')
print(confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred))
print('\nClassification Report:')
print(classification_report(y_true, y_pred, target_names=['Normal', 'Anomaly']))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from statsmodels.tsa.seasonal import seasonal_decompose
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Generate synthetic time series data with anomalies
np.random.seed(42)
time_index = pd.date_range('2023-01-01', periods=365, freq='D')

# Trend + Seasonality + Noise
trend = np.linspace(100, 150, 365)
seasonality = 20 * np.sin(np.arange(365) * 2 * np.pi / 365)
noise = np.random.normal(0, 5, 365)
ts_data = trend + seasonality + noise

# Inject anomalies
ts_data[50] += 80
ts_data[150] += 60
ts_data[250] -= 70

ts_series = pd.Series(ts_data, index=time_index)

# Decompose time series
decomposition = seasonal_decompose(ts_series, model='additive', period=30)

# Calculate residual-based anomalies using z-score
residuals = decomposition.resid
z_scores = np.abs((residuals - residuals.mean()) / residuals.std())
anomalies = z_scores > 3

print(f'Total observations: {len(ts_series)}')
print(f'Anomalies detected: {anomalies.sum()}')
print(f'\nAnomaly dates:')
print(ts_series.index[anomalies])

# Plot decomposition with anomalies highlighted
fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 1, figsize=(12, 10))
ts_series.plot(ax=axes[0], title='Original Time Series')
axes[0].scatter(ts_series.index[anomalies], ts_series[anomalies], color='red', s=100, label='Anomalies')
axes[0].legend()
decomposition.trend.plot(ax=axes[1], title='Trend')
decomposition.seasonal.plot(ax=axes[2], title='Seasonality')
decomposition.resid.plot(ax=axes[3], title='Residuals')
axes[3].scatter(ts_series.index[anomalies], decomposition.resid[anomalies], color='red', s=100)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('time_series_anomalies.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neighbors import LocalOutlierFactor

# Generate time series with anomalies
np.random.seed(42)
n_points = 200
time_series = np.sin(np.linspace(0, 4*np.pi, n_points)) + np.random.normal(0, 0.1, n_points)
time_series[50:52] = 5  # Spike anomaly
time_series[150] = -5   # Dip anomaly

# Create lagged features for LOF
window = 5
X = np.array([time_series[i:i+window] for i in range(len(time_series)-window)])

# Apply Local Outlier Factor
lof = LocalOutlierFactor(n_neighbors=20, contamination=0.05)
predictions = lof.fit_predict(X)

# Align predictions with time series
anomalies = np.zeros(len(time_series))
anomalies[window:] = (predictions == -1).astype(int)

df = pd.DataFrame({
    'time': range(len(time_series)),
    'value': time_series,
    'is_anomaly': anomalies
})

print(f'Time series anomalies:\n{df[df["is_anomaly"] == 1]}')
print(f'Total anomalies: {int(anomalies.sum())}')

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
import torch
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

# Load a small pre-trained model for text embeddings
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('distilbert-base-uncased')
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained('distilbert-base-uncased')

# Create a corpus of text documents
texts = [
    'The weather is sunny today',
    'It is a beautiful day outside',
    'The cat is sleeping peacefully',
    'Birds are flying in the sky',
    'ALERT: System failure detected urgently',  # Anomaly
    'ERROR: Database connection lost critical',  # Anomaly
    'The dog is playing with a ball',
    'Children are running in the park'
]

# Generate embeddings
embeddings = []
for text in texts:
    inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, max_length=512)
    with torch.no_grad():
        outputs = model(**inputs)
    embeddings.append(outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :].numpy())

X_embeddings = np.vstack(embeddings)

# Compute average distance to all other points (isolation score)
similarity_matrix = cosine_similarity(X_embeddings)
np.fill_diagonal(similarity_matrix, 0)
avg_similarities = similarity_matrix.mean(axis=1)

anomalies = avg_similarities < np.percentile(avg_similarities, 25)

for i, (text, is_anomaly) in enumerate(zip(texts, anomalies)):
    label = 'ANOMALY' if is_anomaly else 'Normal'
    print(f'{label}: {text}')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and prepare data
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits

digits = load_digits()
X = digits.data
y = digits.target

# Focus on digit 0 as normal class
normal_mask = y == 0
X_normal = X[normal_mask]
X_test = X[~normal_mask]  # Other digits as anomalies

# Standardize
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_normal_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_normal)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# PCA reconstruction error
pca = PCA(n_components=20, random_state=42)
pca.fit(X_normal_scaled)

# Calculate reconstruction error
X_normal_reconstructed = pca.inverse_transform(pca.transform(X_normal_scaled))
X_test_reconstructed = pca.inverse_transform(pca.transform(X_test_scaled))

error_normal = np.mean((X_normal_scaled - X_normal_reconstructed) ** 2, axis=1)
error_test = np.mean((X_test_scaled - X_test_reconstructed) ** 2, axis=1)

threshold = np.percentile(error_normal, 95)

print(f"Anomalies detected: {anomalies_test.sum()} / {len(error_test)}")
print(f"Detection rate: {100 * anomalies_test.sum() / len(error_test):.1f}%")

# Plot reconstruction errors
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.hist(error_normal, bins=30, alpha=0.7, label='Normal (Digit 0)', density=True)
plt.hist(error_test, bins=30, alpha=0.7, label='Other Digits', density=True)
plt.axvline(threshold, color='r', linestyle='--', label=f'Threshold ({threshold:.3f})')
plt.xlabel('Reconstruction Error')

n_images = 30

images = []
labels = []

# Generate normal images (simple patterns)
for i in range(n_images - 3):
    img = np.zeros((img_size, img_size, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    # Draw normal patterns
    cv2.circle(img, (14, 14), 5 + i % 5, (100, 100, 255), -1)
    cv2.rectangle(img, (5, 5), (23, 23), (100, 255, 100), 1)
    images.append(img)
    labels.append(0)  # normal

# Generate anomalous images (very different patterns)
for i in range(3):
    img = np.zeros((img_size, img_size, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    # Draw anomalous patterns
    for j in range(20):
        cv2.line(img, (0, j * 2), (img_size, j * 2), (255, 0, 255), 1)
    images.append(img)
    labels.append(1)  # anomaly

for img in images:
    # Convert to grayscale and compute histogram

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Simulate network traffic data with time-series seasonality
np.random.seed(42)
date_range = pd.date_range('2024-01-01', periods=720, freq='5min')

# Create normal traffic pattern with daily and hourly seasonality
base_traffic = 1000
trend = np.linspace(0, 100, 720)
hourly_pattern = 500 * np.sin(np.arange(720) * 2 * np.pi / 288)
daily_pattern = 200 * np.sin(np.arange(720) * 2 * np.pi / (288 * 5))
noise = np.random.normal(0, 50, 720)

traffic = base_traffic + trend + hourly_pattern + daily_pattern + noise

df = pd.DataFrame({
    'timestamp': date_range,
    'bytes_transferred': traffic
})

# Inject spike anomalies
df.loc[200:205, 'bytes_transferred'] = 5000
df.loc[500:502, 'bytes_transferred'] = 4500

# Use Z-score on residuals after seasonal decomposition
from statsmodels.tsa.seasonal import seasonal_decompose

decomposition = seasonal_decompose(df['bytes_transferred'], model='additive', period=288)
residuals = decomposition.resid.dropna()
z_scores = np.abs(stats.zscore(residuals))

df_clean = df.iloc[len(df) - len(residuals):].reset_index(drop=True)
df_clean['z_score'] = z_scores.values
df_clean['is_anomaly'] = z_scores.values > 3

print(f"Detected {df_clean['is_anomaly'].sum()} traffic anomalies")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy.spatial.distance import mahalanobis
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 200
n_features = 5

X_normal = np.random.multivariate_normal(
    mean=np.zeros(n_features),
    cov=np.eye(n_features),
    size=n_samples
)

X_anomalies = np.random.uniform(-5, 5, size=(20, n_features))
X = np.vstack([X_normal, X_anomalies])
labels = np.concatenate([np.zeros(n_samples), np.ones(20)])

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

mean = X_scaled.mean(axis=0)
cov = np.cov(X_scaled.T)
cov_inv = np.linalg.inv(cov)

mahal_distances = np.array([
    mahalanobis(x, mean, cov_inv) for x in X_scaled
])

threshold = np.percentile(mahal_distances, 95)
anomalies_detected = mahal_distances > threshold

print(f'Anomaly Detection using Mahalanobis Distance')
print(f'True anomalies: {labels.sum()}')
print(f'Detected anomalies: {anomalies_detected.sum()}')
print(f'Detection threshold: {threshold:.3f}')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.hist(mahal_distances[labels == 0], bins=30, alpha=0.7, label='Normal')
plt.hist(mahal_distances[labels == 1], bins=15, alpha=0.7, label='Anomalies')
plt.axvline(threshold, color='red', linestyle='--', label='Threshold')
plt.xlabel('Mahalanobis Distance')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Anomaly Detection via Mahalanobis Distance')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('mahalanobis_anomalies.png', dpi=100)
plt.close()

    adj_matrix[i, nearest] = 1

import cv2
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.covariance import EllipticEnvelope
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from keras.datasets import mnist

# Load MNIST and flatten images
(X_train, y_train), (X_test, y_test) = mnist.load_data()

# Take a subset for faster processing
X_subset = X_train[:5000]
y_subset = y_train[:5000]

# Flatten and normalize
X_flat = X_subset.reshape(X_subset.shape[0], -1).astype(np.float32) / 255.0

# Reduce dimensionality with PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=50, random_state=42)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_flat)

# Apply Elliptic Envelope for anomaly detection
ee = EllipticEnvelope(contamination=0.05, random_state=42)
anomalies = ee.fit_predict(X_pca)

# Visualize some anomalies
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 5, figsize=(12, 5))
anomaly_indices = np.where(anomalies == -1)[0][:10]

for idx, ax in enumerate(axes.flat):
    if idx < len(anomaly_indices):
        img_idx = anomaly_indices[idx]
        ax.imshow(X_subset[img_idx], cmap='gray')
        ax.set_title(f'Label: {y_subset[img_idx]}')
    ax.axis('off')

plt.suptitle('Detected Anomalies in MNIST')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('mnist_anomalies.png', dpi=100)
plt.close()

print(f'Total samples: {len(X_subset)}')

from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
import torch
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.ensemble import LocalOutlierFactor

model_name = 'distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english'
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(model_name, output_hidden_states=True)
model.eval()

reviews = [
    "Great product, works perfectly!",
    "Excellent quality, highly recommend",
    "Best purchase ever, very satisfied",
    "Love it, great value for money",
    "Amazing item, arrived quickly",
    "Product broke after one day",
    "Not as described, very disappointed",
    "Waste of money, terrible quality",
    "Really bad experience with this",
    "Would buy again, very happy",
    "Perfect fit, couldn't ask for better",
]

# Extract embeddings correctly
embeddings = []
for review in reviews:
    inputs = tokenizer(review, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, max_length=512)
    with torch.no_grad():
        outputs = model(**inputs)
    # Extract pooled representation from hidden states
    hidden_state = outputs.hidden_states[-1]  # Last layer
    cls_embedding = hidden_state[:, 0, :].numpy()  # [CLS] token
    embeddings.append(cls_embedding.flatten())

embeddings_array = np.vstack(embeddings)
print(f"Embeddings shape: {embeddings_array.shape}")
print(f"Number of reviews: {len(reviews)}")

# Detect anomalous reviews using Local Outlier Factor on embeddings

lof_scores = lof.negative_outlier_factor_

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import requests
from io import BytesIO

url = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3a/Cat03.jpg/1200px-Cat03.jpg'
response = requests.get(url)
img = Image.open(BytesIO(response.content))
img.thumbnail((256, 256))

img_array = np.array(img)
original_shape = img_array.shape

# Flatten and preprocess
if len(img_array.shape) == 3:
    flat = img_array.reshape(-1, img_array.shape[2])
else:
    flat = img_array.reshape(-1, 1)

scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled = scaler.fit_transform(flat.astype(np.float32))

pca = PCA(n_components=0.95)
reduced = pca.fit_transform(scaled)

# Reconstruct
reconstructed_scaled = pca.inverse_transform(reduced)
reconstructed = scaler.inverse_transform(reconstructed_scaled)
reconstructed = reconstructed.reshape(original_shape).astype(np.uint8)

axes[0].imshow(img_array)
axes[0].set_title('Original Image')

import torch
from transformers import DistilBertTokenizer, DistilBertForSequenceClassification
import numpy as np

tokenizer = DistilBertTokenizer.from_pretrained('distilbert-base-uncased')
model = DistilBertForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english')
model.eval()
print('Model loaded successfully for sentiment analysis')

texts = [
    'This movie is absolutely fantastic and I loved every minute of it!',
    'I hated this film, it was boring and waste of time.',
    'The plot was interesting but the acting was terrible.',
    'Best movie I have seen in years, highly recommended!',
    'Not bad, some good scenes but could be better.'
]
print('Texts to analyze:')
for i, text in enumerate(texts, 1):
    print(f'{i}. {text}')

predictions = []
for text in texts:
    inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, max_length=512)
    with torch.no_grad():
        outputs = model(**inputs)
    logits = outputs.logits
    probabilities = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    predicted_label = torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1).item()
    confidence = probabilities[0][predicted_label].item()
    sentiment = 'POSITIVE' if predicted_label == 1 else 'NEGATIVE'
    predictions.append({
        'text': text,
        'sentiment': sentiment,
        'confidence': confidence
    })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(predictions)
print('\nSentiment Analysis Results:')
print(results_df)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
colors = ['#2ecc71' if s == 'POSITIVE' else '#e74c3c' for s in results_df['sentiment']]

ax.set_yticks(range(len(results_df)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"Text {i+1}" for i in range(len(results_df))])
ax.set_xlabel('Confidence Score')
ax.set_title('Sentiment Analysis Confidence Scores')
ax.set_xlim([0, 1])
for i, (conf, sent) in enumerate(zip(results_df['confidence'], results_df['sentiment'])):
    ax.text(conf + 0.02, i, f'{sent}', va='center')

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from torchvision import datasets, transforms
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

transform = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize((0.1307,), (0.3081,))
])

train_dataset = datasets.MNIST(root='./data', train=True, download=True, transform=transform)
test_dataset = datasets.MNIST(root='./data', train=False, download=True, transform=transform)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=128, shuffle=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=128, shuffle=False)

print(f'Training samples: {len(train_dataset)}')
print(f'Test samples: {len(test_dataset)}')

class SimpleNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(SimpleNN, self).__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(784, 128)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 64)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(64, 10)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.2)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.view(-1, 784)
        x = self.relu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.relu(self.fc2(x))
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.fc3(x)
        return x

model = SimpleNN()
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)

print(model)

num_epochs = 5
train_losses = []

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    epoch_loss = 0.0
    
    for batch_idx, (data, target) in enumerate(train_loader):
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        output = model(data)
        loss = criterion(output, target)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        epoch_loss += loss.item()
    
    avg_loss = epoch_loss / len(train_loader)
    train_losses.append(avg_loss)
    print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs}, Loss: {avg_loss:.4f}')

model.eval()
correct = 0
total = 0

with torch.no_grad():
    for data, target in test_loader:
        output = model(data)
        _, predicted = torch.max(output.data, 1)
        total += target.size(0)
        correct += (predicted == target).sum().item()
